description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the IniFileReader class, focusing on token splitting, parsing quoted tokens, and reading metadata from INI files, using JUnit framework.

classes.name: IniFileReaderTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for IniFileReader functionalities, such as token splitting, handling quoted tokens, and reading INI file metadata.

methods.name: testSplit
methods.description: Tests the splitTokens method for different input strings, verifying correct tokenization.

methods.name: testQuotedTokens
methods.description: Verifies that tokens enclosed in quotes are correctly processed by splitTokens.

methods.name: testRealLine
methods.description: Tests parsing of a typical INI line with multiple tokens, including key-value pairs.

methods.name: testTotalPagesSize
methods.description: Reads a sample INI content and verifies that metadata such as number of pages, signature, page size, and commands are correctly parsed.
